findings.title: A product-3 (ACCRUAL PERIODIC) transfer clears the product->GL mapping gate and then refuses at the ASSET_TRANSFER financial-activity account (id 100), which is not configured in tenant gerege
findings.supersedesAssumption: The OH-INV-W brief's premise -- that OH-GL-R/OH-GL-T's product-3 accountingMappings set (12 rows) is sufficient to let the transfer settle -- is FALSE on this oracle. A SECOND reference row is required: the financial-activity account for ASSET_TRANSFER (100). The first gate (INVQ-COB-REFUSAL, product 2 LOAN PORTFOLIO mapping) is passed; the transfer then refuses at the next gate. This is the same class of seed/reference-data gap the brief warned can survive in a written record -- stated loudly here so it is not inherited as 'product 3 unblocks settlement'.
observed: State verified live before the attempt: loan product 3 OHLGR-Accrual-Loan accountingRule = accountingRuleType.accrual.periodic (ACCRUAL PERIODIC); product 2 = accountingRuleType.none (NONE, INVQ-COB-REFUSAL root cause); loans 10 (OHGLR-L01), 11 (OHGLR-L02) and 12 (OHLGT-L03) are all product 3 and Active.
acc_product_mapping for product 3 = 12 rows (acc_gl_account gl_code LIKE 'OHLGR%' ids 5..16 = 12 rows). The OH-GL-T brief says 11 -- the ORACLE has 12. ORACLE WINS; the brief's 11 is stale.

GET /jobs/LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS/steps still carries EXTERNAL_ASSET_OWNER_TRANSFER at order 7 (CHECK_LOAN_REPAYMENT_DUE=3, APPLY_CHARGE_TO_OVERDUE_LOANS=1, LOAN_DELINQUENCY_CLASSIFICATION=2, CHECK_LOAN_REPAYMENT_OVERDUE=4, UPDATE_LOAN_ARREARS_AGING=5, ADD_PERIODIC_ACCRUAL_ENTRIES=6).

Transfer 17 created on loan 12 (product 3), settlementDate 2026-09-02, purchasePriceRatio '97.25' (a JSON String), status PENDING. POST returned HTTP 200 {resourceId:17, subResourceId:12, resourceExternalId:'OHINVW-Tr-12', subResourceExternalId:'OHLGT-L03'}.

Business date advanced 2026-09-02 -> 2026-09-03 by job 32 (Increase Business Date by 1 day); the derived COB date advanced 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-02. Transfer 17's settlementDate 2026-09-02 equals the job's COB date, so LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep.java:82-87 selects it.

POST /jobs/34?command=executeJob returned HTTP 202 with an EMPTY body; job 34 (Loan COB, LA_ECOB) job-level lastRunHistory.status = success. The investor step failure is caught per-loan by AbstractLoanItemListener and downgraded to WARN, then skipped -- so job-level success does NOT mean the step succeeded.
Application log (COB-Thread-21, 2026-09-10 04:06:45.992Z): BusinessStepException for Loan(id=12) on five attempts (COB-Thread-21..25), then 'Skipping was triggered during processing of Loan (id=12)'.

Root cause (source, pinned 426a23544): FinancialActivityAccountNotFoundException: Financial Activity account with for the financial Activity with Id 100 does not exist, thrown at FinancialActivityAccountRepositoryWrapper.java:48 from InvestorAccountingHelper.getLinkedGLAccountForLoanProduct (:120). ASSET_TRANSFER(100) is a non-null FinancialActivity (AccountingConstants.java:438; fromInt at :491), so isOrganizationAccount (InvestorAccountingHelper.java:135-137) takes the ORGANIZATION branch (InvestorAccountingHelper.java:118-121) instead of the product-mapping branch, and looks up a financial-activity row rather than a product mapping. Call path, in the order the captured stack prints it (out/loan-12-cob-refusal-invw.txt:66-70 then :49-54): LoanAccountOwnerTransferBusinessStep.java:189 -> :169 -> :119 -> :108 -> :55 -> JournalEntryWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl.java:855 -> AccountingServiceImpl.java:65 -> :115 -> :277 -> InvestorAccountingHelper.java:72 -> :120 -> FinancialActivityAccountRepositoryWrapper.java:48.
